management_revenue_y1.name: Management-case Year-1 revenue
management_revenue_y1.formula: 31.36% mature occupancy * one on-site meal per guest per day * €25 ticket

management_occupancy.name: Management-case mature occupancy
management_occupancy.formula: Day-weighted average of the management monthly series

market_occupancy.name: INE Segovia market occupancy
market_occupancy.formula: Day-weighted average of the INE monthly series

funding_gap_close.name: Funding gap at close
funding_gap_close.formula: Sources at close - uses at close (CapEx + VAT + pre-opening + WC + DSRA)

credit_line_drawn_y1.name: Credit line / VAT bridge drawn in Year 1
credit_line_drawn_y1.formula: Model credit_line_drawn (VAT bridge) at end of Year 1

phase2_cash_need.name: Phase II cash need (net CapEx + VAT)

phase2_funding_gap.name: Phase II funding gap
phase2_funding_gap.formula: Phase I cash at end of Year 2 - Phase II cash need

project_irr_exit.name: Project IRR with 8.5% exit (management case)
project_irr_exit.formula: Unlevered FCF + terminal value at 8.5% cap rate

guardrail_audit_rules.description: Assets must equal liabilities plus equity across all three cases.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Verify VAT credit and financing facilities are balanced across CFO, CFI and CFF.

guardrail_audit_rules.description: Lodging and restaurant revenue must be taxed at 10%, not 21%.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Recalibrate output VAT to Ley 37/1992 art. 91.Uno.2.2º.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: CapEx input VAT recognised as a fiscal asset
guardrail_audit_rules.description: 21% input VAT on CapEx must be booked as a receivable, not expensed.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Book the Modelo 303/390 deductible VAT asset and disclose the bridge facility.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: Payroll hourly compliance (SMI 2026 and Segovia convenio)
guardrail_audit_rules.description: Each part-time role's gross hourly cost must be at least the SMI and the convenio reference.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: If the contracts are full-time, the annual salaries are below the convenio. Document the part-time hours.

guardrail_audit_rules.description: The management case must meet the 1.25x bank covenant in Year 1.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: If DSCR < 1.25x, inject equity, extend the grace period or reduce debt.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: Adjusted Year-1 cash after omitted close-day uses
guardrail_audit_rules.description: Year-1 cash must remain positive after pre-opening, working capital and DSRA.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Fund the €70.8k close-day gap with additional equity or a larger facility.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: DSRA sizing vs. six months of debt service
guardrail_audit_rules.description: The DSRA must cover at least six months of senior debt service.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Pledge the DSRA in escrow before financial close.

guardrail_audit_rules.description: Close-day sources must cover close-day uses.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Add €70.8k of equity or a larger VAT/working-capital facility.

guardrail_audit_rules.description: The model's Year-1 VAT bridge must not exceed the stated €50k revolving line.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Disclose the VAT bridge as a separate €153k facility or increase the line to €150k.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: Management occupancy vs. INE market benchmark
guardrail_audit_rules.description: The management case should not exceed 1.10x the official INE market occupancy without justification.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Present the 31.36% case as an upside case and lead with the 21.24% market case.

guardrail_audit_rules.description: Phase II may proceed only if Phase I cash covers the full Phase II cash need.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Do not double-count the LEADER grant and VAT refund. Raise €241.6k or phase the expansion.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: Project IRR with exit vs. 8% WACC
guardrail_audit_rules.description: The management-case project IRR with an 8.5% exit cap rate must exceed the 8% WACC.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: If IRR < WACC, the exit cap rate or the operating assumptions must be revisited.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: Promoter-case replication of the original simulator
guardrail_audit_rules.description: The promoter case must reproduce the original Excel's Year-1 revenue (€86,275) and EBITDA (€11,297).
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Reconcile the original Excel units, prices and opex.

guardrail_audit_rules.description: The independent INE market case must also meet the 1.25x covenant.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: At 21.24% occupancy the project does not cover debt service. Re-size the debt or add equity.
